name: Goodra
normal: purple-lilac body, pinkish-lavender belly/arms, dark eyes
shiny: body yellow/gold with pink tones (search summary: white-purple becomes yellow-pink)
source: Bulbapedia/Serebii 403 or image-only; fandomspot.com best-pokemon-xy-kalos-shinies; touchtapplay; remainder from memory

name: Trevenant
normal: brown bark body, green leaf foliage, yellow glowing eyes
shiny: foliage becomes orange afro-like, white face markings, bark stays brown
source: Bulbapedia/Serebii 403 or image-only; fandomspot.com best-pokemon-xy-kalos-shinies; touchtapplay; remainder from memory

name: Diancie
normal: pink crystal body with lavender-grey and white facets
shiny: pink diamonds kept, lavender facets turn neutral grey and darker, white facets turn hot pink
desc: lavender facets desaturate to dark grey, white facets turn pink
source: pokemondb.net HOME sprites (base form), normal vs shiny, measured in OKLCh
note: Re-measured, unchanged. Pink hue 315-360 unchanged; lavender hue 285-300 (26% of pixels, C0.05, L0.73) -> neutral grey (C0.00, L0.60); near-white (21%) -> hot pink hue 349 C0.17 L0.76. White-to-pink needs a lightness drop the grey rule cannot do, so chroma is held to 0.06 (higher chroma raised collateral). Error 0.103 -> 0.062.

name: Salandit
normal: dark grey body, orange belly/spots, small violet accent
shiny: body turns light grey (L ~0.39 to 0.67, near-neutral); orange belly keeps its hue but gets lighter and less saturated; violet accent loses chroma
desc: dark grey body becomes light grey; orange belly lighter, violet accent paler
source: pokemondb HOME normal+shiny sprites, re-measured pixel-by-pixel in OKLCh; rules simulated with the make_shiny_pack recolor
note: Re-measured. Orange hue 36>33, C 0.162>0.133, L 0.59>0.75 (sim lands at C 0.118, L 0.74). Violet accent (1.4% px) C 0.081>0.048. The 77% grey body lightens a lot (L 0.39>0.67) but grey rules only set hue/chroma, so that lightening is not expressible; only the orange and violet are handled.

name: Bewear
normal: pink fur (hue ~5, C 0.09), dark grey limbs, white/cream
shiny: pink fur turns yellow-gold (hue ~78, C 0.143); dark grey limbs a bit lighter; white unchanged
source: pokemondb HOME normal+shiny sprites, re-measured pixel-by-pixel in OKLCh; rules simulated with the make_shiny_pack recolor
note: Re-measured; original rule confirmed. Fur hue 5>78 with C 0.091>0.143 (sim hue 78, C 0.142, mean error 0.016). Pale pink pixels at hue ~358 also move to ~74 (shiny ~86). White (C<0.01) untouched. Dark grey lightening (L 0.33>0.42) not expressible.

name: Golisopod
normal: pale shell with faint green-teal tint, magenta/purple accents (hue ~319), teal-grey accents (hue ~171)
shiny: shell becomes neutral white/grey; purple accents turn red-orange (hue ~27); teal-grey accents turn blue (hue ~241) and lighter
desc: purple accents turn red-orange, teal-grey accents blue, shell tint neutral
source: pokemondb HOME normal+shiny sprites, re-measured pixel-by-pixel in OKLCh; rules simulated with the make_shiny_pack recolor
note: Re-measured. Magenta hue 319>27 (C 0.120>0.135): sim hue 27, C 0.131. Teal accent hue 171>241 (C 0.044>0.104, L 0.58>0.63): sim hue 238, C 0.101. Shell greys C ~0.02>~0. Source windows centered on measured means (was 310 and 170) so the hue lands exactly.

name: Drampa
shiny: teal parts turn tan-gold/orange-brown (hue ~75), lighter and more saturated; cream fur slightly more yellow
desc: teal mane and tail turn tan-orange; cream fur a touch warmer
source: pokemondb HOME normal+shiny sprites, re-measured pixel-by-pixel in OKLCh; rules simulated with the make_shiny_pack recolor
note: Re-measured. Teal bins (hue 160-190, 24% px) 100% moved to hue ~75, C 0.077>0.093, L 0.62>0.71; sim hue 74, C 0.092. Added a narrow rule for the pale yellow-green cream band (hue 113, C 0.052, 12% px) which goes to hue ~103, C 0.072, L +0.06. Near-white cream (C<0.03) is left alone. Tiny yellow patch (hue 90-100, 2%) goes dark violet: ignored.

name: Absol
normal: white fur with faint cool tint, blue face/legs (hue ~250, C 0.11), red eyes
shiny: blue face/legs turn salmon-pink/red (hue ~30, lighter); white fur gets a faint lavender tint (hue ~305-314, C ~0.025)
desc: blue face and legs turn salmon pink; fur faintly lavender
source: pokemondb HOME normal+shiny sprites, re-measured pixel-by-pixel in OKLCh; rules simulated with the make_shiny_pack recolor
note: Re-measured; original rule confirmed. Blue hue 250>30, L 0.55>0.72, C ~0.115 (sim hue 31, L 0.72, error 0.024). Fur C 0.013-0.018 hue ~230>~310 C ~0.025 (sim hue 295-304). Red eyes (hue ~29) are outside the blue window.

name: Golurk
normal: teal-cyan body (hue ~206, C 0.056), brown-gold bands (hue ~64), bright blue seals (hue ~226, C 0.10), yellow glow (hue ~97)
shiny: body turns grey-teal (hue ~192, C 0.032); bands desaturate to dull brown-olive (hue ~76, C 0.06, darker); seals turn dark slate (hue ~250-265, C ~0.04, darker); yellow glow turns vivid green (hue ~130, C ~0.2)
desc: teal body greys out, blue seals go slate, yellow glow turns green, gold bands dull
source: pokemondb HOME normal+shiny sprites, re-measured pixel-by-pixel in OKLCh; rules simulated with the make_shiny_pack recolor
note: Re-measured. Body 206>192 C 0.056>0.032; seals hue 226>249 C 0.10>0.04 L 0.59>0.50; bands hue 64>76 C 0.097>0.061 L 0.64>0.58; glow hue 97>130 C 0.086>0.195. Windows re-centered on measured source hues (old 207/232/90/70 windows overlapped; seal and body windows now 191-215 vs 223-243). Overall sim error 0.053>0.011.

name: Noivern
normal: violet-purple body and wings, yellow-orange ear tips
shiny: purple becomes pale green with blood-red contrast (fandomspot)
source: Bulbapedia/Serebii 403 or image-only; fandomspot.com best-pokemon-xy-kalos-shinies; touchtapplay; remainder from memory

name: Eldegoss
normal: yellow-green leaves (hue ~90-115, C 0.14-0.15), white cotton, brown stem (hue ~65)
shiny: leaves turn salmon/rose-pink (hue ~23-60 depending on shading, C ~0.07, slightly darker); white cotton and stem unchanged
source: pokemondb HOME normal+shiny sprites, re-measured pixel-by-pixel in OKLCh; rules simulated with the make_shiny_pack recolor
note: Re-measured; original rule kept (a grid scan of center/target/width/scales found nothing meaningfully better, error 0.056>0.038). Shiny leaf hue varies 23-60 with lightness (lighter leaves go orange-salmon ~50, darker ones rose ~23), so a single hue shift is an approximation. Stem (hue ~65) and white cotton are unchanged and stay outside the window.

name: Applin
normal: red apple shell (hue ~17, C 0.15), lime-green body and brown worm parts
shiny: red apple turns green (hue ~137, C ~0.123); lime-green and brown parts unchanged
source: pokemondb HOME normal+shiny sprites, re-measured pixel-by-pixel in OKLCh; rules simulated with the make_shiny_pack recolor
note: Re-measured. Apple hue 17>137 C 0.149>0.123 (sim hue 137, C 0.123). Brown (hue ~70) and lime (hue ~128) bins are 0-1% changed and sit outside the window (-11..45). Source recentered on 17 (was 12).

name: Silicobra
normal: sand body (hue ~90-100, C 0.067), yellow-green hood accents (hue ~128, C 0.19), cream underside (C 0.03-0.04)
shiny: sand body desaturates to pale olive (C ~0.045) with a slight shift toward yellow-green on darker shading; green accents shift to yellow-lime (hue ~102, C 0.15); cream unchanged
desc: sandy body goes pale olive, green accents go yellow
source: pokemondb HOME normal+shiny sprites, re-measured pixel-by-pixel in OKLCh; rules simulated with the make_shiny_pack recolor
note: Re-measured. Body (87% px) C 0.067>0.045, shiny hue 112 at L 0.5-0.6 but ~70-85 on the lightest sand, so the hue move is a compromise (grid-scan best; error 0.032>0.026). Accent hue 128>102 C 0.19>0.15 matches exactly. Cream underside (C ~0.035, L>0.85) stays near the chroma gate and is only lightly touched.

name: Snom
normal: white/pale body with faint blue tint (C ~0.014), blue-lavender underside (hue ~262-273, C 0.04-0.06)
shiny: white/pale body gets a mint/lime-green tint (hue ~130-160, C ~0.03); blue-lavender parts stay blue (hue ~245-250)
desc: white body gets a pale mint-green tint
source: pokemondb HOME normal+shiny sprites, re-measured pixel-by-pixel in OKLCh; rules simulated with the make_shiny_pack recolor
note: Re-measured. White body (61% px, L ~0.94) C 0.014>0.031 hue 251>151. The original grey range 0.8-1.0 also caught the pale-blue underside (L 0.8-0.88, C 0.03-0.045) and turned it green (hue 262>210) while the shiny keeps it blue; raising Lmin to 0.88 fixes that (error 0.029>0.021).

name: Frosmoth
normal: white fuzz, pale blue-lavender wings (hue ~273, C ~0.04), some deeper blue accents
shiny: about half of the pale wings turn mint/teal (hue ~180-210, C ~0.045); the other half and the white fuzz stay lavender/white; a few strong blue pixels turn teal (hue ~198)
source: pokemondb HOME normal+shiny sprites, re-measured pixel-by-pixel in OKLCh; rules simulated with the make_shiny_pack recolor
note: Re-measured. Of the pale-wing pixels (C 0.03-0.07, L 0.7-0.88), 43% go to hue 150-210 and 43% stay at 270-300; changed ones sit at L 0.79-0.82, but the unchanged overlap that band so they cannot be separated. Upper L limit lowered from 0.88 to 0.85 and hue set to 180 (scan best, error 0.0255>0.0212). White fuzz (L>0.88) untouched. A hue rule for the strong blue pixels was skipped because it would also catch the unchanged lavender wings.

name: Pumpkaboo
normal: brown body (hue ~66, C 0.05), pink-red parts (hue ~34, C 0.11), yellow-orange glow (hue 75-105)
shiny: brown body turns neutral dark grey (C ~0, L 0.54>0.40); pink-red parts turn purple-magenta (hue ~329, L 0.68>0.51); yellow glow stays yellow, slightly lighter and greener
desc: brown body turns grey, pink-red parts turn purple
source: pokemondb HOME normal+shiny sprites, re-measured pixel-by-pixel in OKLCh; rules simulated with the make_shiny_pack recolor
note: Re-measured. Body hue 66, C 0.05>0.00, L ~0.55>0.40; pink hue 34>329, L 0.67>0.50. The old brown rule 70>70:15 reached the orange glow (hue 75-90, C 0.15) and drained its chroma; narrowed to 62>62:9 (error 0.018>0.015). Glow hue 75-90 actually goes to ~111 and lighter, not expressible without hitting the brown.
